top_5_topics.title: India-Iran 10-Year Agreement on Chabahar Port
top_5_topics.summary: India Ports Global Limited signed a historic 10-year contract with Iran's Ports and Maritime Organization to equip and operate the Shahid Beheshti Terminal at Chabahar Port.
top_5_topics.relevance: Crucial for India's strategic connectivity to Central Asia, Eurasia, and the INSTC, bypassing Pakistan.

top_5_topics.title: RBI Surplus Transfer to the Central Government
top_5_topics.gs_paper: GS Paper III - Indian Economy and Fiscal Policy
top_5_topics.summary: The Reserve Bank of India approved a record surplus transfer of ₹2.11 lakh crore to the Union Government for the accounting year 2023-24.
top_5_topics.relevance: Provides significant fiscal space to the government to manage fiscal deficit targets while maintaining capital spending.

top_5_topics.title: Supreme Court Ruling on Grounds of Arrest Under PMLA
top_5_topics.gs_paper: GS Paper II - Indian Constitution & Governance
top_5_topics.summary: The Supreme Court ruled that the Enforcement Directorate must supply written grounds of arrest to the accused at the time of arrest without exception.
top_5_topics.relevance: Reinforces fundamental rights under Article 22(1) and personal liberty against arbitrary state action.

top_5_topics.title: WMO Report on Global Heatwaves and Climate Anomalies
top_5_topics.gs_paper: GS Paper III - Environment, Disaster Management & Ecology
top_5_topics.summary: The World Meteorological Organization highlighted continuing unprecedented rise in ocean heat content and surface temperatures due to anthropogenic greenhouse gases.
top_5_topics.relevance: Directly links to global climate commitments, Paris Agreement targets, and climate adaptation strategies.

top_5_topics.title: Successful Testing of Astra Indigenous Beyond-Visual-Range Missile
top_5_topics.gs_paper: GS Paper III - Science & Technology / Indigenisation of Tech
top_5_topics.summary: DRDO and the Indian Air Force successfully integrated and flight-tested the Astra Beyond Visual Range (BVR) air-to-air missile from LCA Tejas.
top_5_topics.relevance: Pertains to Atmanirbhar Bharat in defense technology and enhancing tactical air capability.
